data.body: RCA (2026-09-08): reducer.marker guards the import by assigning fcntl = None, but write_marker and clear_marker dereference fcntl.flock unconditionally in both acquire and finally-unlock paths. On platforms without fcntl this raises AttributeError, and the finally path can replace the original exception, violating the documented best-effort never-raises marker contract. The narrow fix is to guard both acquire and unlock; when no fcntl exists the marker write/clear remains best-effort and proceeds without the POSIX advisory serialization rather than raising.
